description: Tools for recording observations about the external world

tools.name: record_world_observation
tools.description: Record an observation about the external world - news events, patterns in the world, notable occurrences, or changes you've noticed. Use this to build world awareness that persists across sessions.

observation.description: What you've observed about the world

source.description: Where you learned about this (e.g., 'user mentioned', 'news fetch', 'pattern noticed')

tools.name: get_world_context
tools.description: Get current world context - location, weather, time of day, season, and any recent world observations. Use this to ground yourself in the present moment.

include_observations.description: Whether to include recent world observations

user_id.description: Optional user ID to get their location context
